title: Create the single canonical domain model and one time base

checks.name: canonical_artifact_envelope
checks.evidence: ArtifactEnvelope requires the exact v2.2 schema label, exact canonical payload authority, deep immutability and a locally computed canonical content digest.

checks.name: canonical_24000_tick_timebase
checks.evidence: Registered tests prove the sole 24000 tick time base, half-open ranges and segment-local zero origin.

checks.name: draft_artifact_separation
checks.evidence: Registered tests mechanically reject ID, hash, tick, timeline, VEC and release authority fields from creative Draft schemas.

checks.name: no_duplicate_domain_authority
checks.evidence: All canonical domain types have one declaration in the domain package; ScriptFact, FactSemantic and FactRegistry are re-exported from that authority rather than redefined.

checks.name: domain_schemas_frozen_for_downstream
checks.evidence: Every domain module declares schema 2.2, all canonical dataclasses are frozen, and ArtifactEnvelope rejects a v2.2 payload mislabeled as schema 2.1.

checks.name: legacy_read_adapter_only
checks.evidence: Compatibility imports remain one-way and read-only. The explicit legacy fact adapter remints a local ID, defaults missing semantics to narrative, validates supplied source support and requires re-ingest for reference or dialogue use.

checks.name: typed_fact_semantics
checks.evidence: FactKind now represents source authority while the independent FactSemantic enum represents narrative, character, wardrobe, prop, setting, dialogue, continuity or asset meaning. Subject and dialogue field requirements are fail-closed.

checks.name: opaque_fact_ids
checks.evidence: ScriptFact accepts only local script_fact identities with an ordinal-bound SHA-256 body; semantic labels and legacy prefixes are rejected, and semantic lookup uses the typed field only.

checks.name: source_span_invariants
checks.evidence: ScriptFact enforces non-empty half-open character spans and non-negative ordinals; source validation rejects BOM/CR input, out-of-bounds spans, unsupported statements and dialogue text absent from the source span. FactRegistry enforces strictly increasing unique ordinals per source document.

informational_results.name: failure_first_v22_contract
informational_results.result: Before implementation: 5 failed, 18 passed; missing FactSemantic, legacy fact adapter and schema 2.2 declarations were observed.

informational_results.name: domain_compat_compile_local
informational_results.result: Canonical domain and compatibility modules compiled successfully.

findings: The v2.1 ScriptFact conflated provenance with semantic meaning and omitted source spans, ordinals, subjects and spoken text.
Fact consumers therefore had no canonical semantic field and downstream code resorted to parsing fact_id prefixes.
Canonical modules declared schema 2.1 after the v2.2 breaking contract amendment, while ArtifactEnvelope accepted mismatched schema labels.
No explicit compatibility path existed for old ScriptFact records.
review.root_cause: The prior A1 schema was frozen before the ingest-to-VEC semantic boundary was specified. A8 exposed that A5 depended on accidental ID naming rather than typed canonical data, requiring an upstream v2.2 domain correction.

considered_options.option: Keep v2.1 ScriptFact and teach A5 more ID prefixes
considered_options.reason: It preserves semantic coupling to identity strings and cannot prove source or dialogue provenance.

considered_options.option: Add optional semantic fields with permissive legacy defaults in the canonical constructor
considered_options.reason: It lets new artifacts silently enter with ambiguous semantics and weakens fail-closed assembly.

considered_options.option: Make the v2.2 fields mandatory and isolate old records behind an explicit read adapter
considered_options.reason: It gives every downstream consumer one typed authority while preserving read-only legacy access without semantic guessing.

remaining_risks: Invalidated A5 code still parses legacy ID prefixes and must be replaced only when A5 becomes the unique next task.
Invalidated A6 services still duplicate projection classes and must be removed only in A6.
A4 must implement FactExtractionDraft and the deterministic assembler that calls source-span validation; A8 must prove the full ingest path.
